new_value: {"notes":"Blocks crate-jmap JMAP-v9py.15.6 (outbound deliveryState aggregation).\nDECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: for group chats the aggregate deliveryState is the best state any recipient has reached (pending \u003c delivered \u003c received); it is \"failed\" only when every recipient has permanently failed. Partial failure never downgrades the aggregate; retries to one peer never change other recipients' states. deliveryReceipts stays OPTIONAL ('if supported'). Edit: rewrite federation-00 L780 and the L788-789 bullets to match, keep the L793 paragraph (reworded to the best-state rule). Rationale (Mark): the internet fails in pieces; surface what worked, don't fail when a peer goes down."}
